### NAME

`mssql-cli` - Command-line interface for SQL Server with autocompletion.

### SYNOPSIS & usage

*Derived from the upstream README at generation
time; verify against `--help` where the tool is
installed.*

```
python -m pip install mssql-cli
```

```
mssql-cli -S <server URL> -d <database name> -U <username> -P <password>
```

### DESCRIPTION (upstream)
